BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE student_practice_evidence_receipt (
    evidence_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_instance_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_revision_id uuid NOT NULL,
    submission_id uuid NOT NULL,
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    outcome varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK (outcome = 'passed'),
    assistance_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    hints_used integer NOT NULL CHECK (hints_used BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
    max_hint_level smallint CHECK (max_hint_level BETWEEN 1 AND 7),
    teacher_assistance_used boolean NOT NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (policy_version = 'practice-competency-evidence-v1'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (student_id, task_instance_id, submission_id),
    CHECK (submission_id = evidence_id),
    CHECK ((hints_used = 0 AND max_hint_level IS NULL) OR (hints_used > 0 AND max_hint_level IS NOT NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE student_practice_target_evidence (
    evidence_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_practice_evidence_receipt(evidence_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_instance_id uuid NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('concept','capability')),
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    correctness numeric(6,5) NOT NULL CHECK (correctness BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    independence numeric(6,5) NOT NULL CHECK (independence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    confidence numeric(6,5) NOT NULL CHECK (confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    step_ids jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(step_ids) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(step_ids) > 0),
    support_context varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (support_context IN ('independent','guided')),
    evidence_kind varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (evidence_kind IN ('independent_application','assisted_application')),
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (evidence_id,target_type,target_key,target_version)
);

CREATE INDEX student_practice_target_evidence_target_idx ON student_practice_target_evidence(student_id,target_type,target_key,target_version,occurred_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE student_practice_target_mastery_audit (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    evidence_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_practice_evidence_receipt(evidence_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    evidence_kind varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    previous_state varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    next_state varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    previous_mastery_score numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    next_mastery_score numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    previous_confidence numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    next_confidence numeric(6,5) NOT NULL,
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (policy_version = 'student-mastery-v1'),
    evidence_occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    processed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (evidence_id,target_type,target_key,target_version,policy_version)
);

COMMIT;
